objective: Evaluate the locked pulmonary-embolism classifier on an external hospital cohort at the participant level.

questions.text: Does the locked classifier meet prespecified discrimination, calibration, and sensitivity criteria externally?

inputs.description: Eligible contrast-enhanced chest CT examinations with participant identifiers and acquisition metadata.
Frozen model weights, preprocessing definition, operating threshold, and software environment.

units.description: Independent participant used for splitting and primary inference.
Eligible CT examination nested within a participant.

outcomes.definition: Adjudicated presence or absence of acute pulmonary embolism.

analysis_sets.definition: Consecutive eligible participants from the external hospital with an adjudicated reference standard.

approvals: IRB approval or exemption must cover external model evaluation.
restrictions: Retain DICOM and identifiers in approved clinical storage.

steps.purpose: Confirm model, preprocessing, threshold, test cohort, and metrics were fixed before evaluation.
steps.method: Signed evaluation manifest and participant-level cohort ledger.

steps.purpose: Estimate discrimination, calibration, operating-point performance, and subgroup uncertainty.
steps.method: Participant-level metrics with bootstrap confidence intervals and calibration assessment.

required_outputs.description: Primary and subgroup metrics with confidence intervals and denominators.
Calibration display with source data and uncertainty.

validation.criterion: No participant appears in model development and external evaluation data.

medical_imaging_model_evaluation.intended_use: Flag suspected pulmonary embolism on contrast-enhanced chest CT for radiologist prioritization.
medical_imaging_model_evaluation.reference_standard: Independent adjudication by two thoracic radiologists with consensus resolution.
